interactives.text: Learn To Play Learn the basics of how to play chess. Chess.com Team 12 Lessons Beginner
Play Like Gukesh Dommaraju Test yourself against the best games of the world chess champion! NM Jeremy Kane 5 Lessons Mastery

Jan's Four Knights Grandmaster Jan Gustafsson teaches you how to react to 3.Nc3 in the most ambitious manner. This is essential viewing if you play either side of the Four Knights. GM Jan Gustafsson 4 Lessons Mastery
Gambit Buffet Grandmaster Simon Williams combines an introduction to gambits after the first move 1.e4 with some famous games from chess history! GM Simon Williams 16 Lessons Mastery

Yusupov On Aronian: Fighting For The Initiative With Black GM Artur Yusupov demonstrates how GM Levon Aronian, one of the best players this century fights for the initiative and wins with the black pieces. GM GMArturYusupovAuthor 3 Lessons Mastery

A Personal Look At Mikhail Tal's Games Tal, nicknamed the “Magician from Riga,” was a gregarious and unworldly genius who overwhelmed his opponents with dazzling attacking chess. He made a strong impression on a young future Russian Champion: Peter Svidler. GM Peter Svidler 6 Lessons Mastery

Prophylactic Thinking Artur Yusupov is back! The former World Number 3, famous coach, and pupil of Mark Dvoretsky, shares one of his secret weapons: prophylaxis. GM GMArturYusupovAuthor 7 Lessons Mastery

Calculation With Dvoretsky In 2016, GM Jan Gustafsson sat down to discuss calculation with the legendary trainer, Mark Dvoretsky. Learn from their in-depth conversation. IM Mark Dvoretsky 6 Lessons Mastery
Loek's Endgame Strategy Eight-time Dutch Champion, Loek van Wely teaches us the practical side of endgames at the grandmaster level! GM Loek van Wely 8 Lessons Mastery

How A Prodigy Plays Chess Indian prodigy Praggnanandhaa Rameshbabu showcases some of the best games of his young but hugely successful career, divided into three main themes: attacking the king, logical play, and coming back from a match deficit! GM Praggnanandhaa Rameshbabu 8 Lessons Mastery
Strategies For Rapid Chess GM Liem Le offers his insights for successful play at faster time controls, based on his personal experience and practice. GM Liem Le 4 Lessons Mastery
Artur Yusupov: On Magnus Carlsen Two top grandmasters, Artur Yusupow and Jan Gustafsson look at the reasons behind Magnus Carlsen's remarkable success. GM GMArturYusupovAuthor 5 Lessons Mastery
The Most Amazing Chess Moves Ever Played GM Surya Ganguly demonstrates the greatest chess moves every played with every piece! GM Surya Shekhar Ganguly 7 Lessons Mastery
How To Win With Zugzwang GM Dejan Bojkov explains how to use zugzwang to win games and tie your opponents in knots! GM Dejan Bojkov 5 Lessons Mastery
c3 Sicil For The Kill FM James Canty teaches his favorite opening weapon, the c3 Sicilian! FM James Canty 5 Lessons Mastery
Judit Polgar: From Child Star To Super-Grandmaster IM Danny Rensch interviews GM Judit Polgar about highlights from her amazing career! GM Judit Polgar 6 Lessons Mastery
The Ultimate Blunder GM Ben Finegold shows the biggest mistake you can make in chess, resigning in a winning or drawn position. GM Ben Finegold 4 Lessons

Hall of Fame | The 50 Greatest Chess Players of All Time Grandmasters Jan Gustafsson and Peter Heine Nielsen bring your their list of the 50 greatest chess players in history! GM Jan Gustafsson 50 Lessons Mastery

Magnus Carlsen's Stonewall World Champion Magnus Carlsen teaches you how to play the Stonewall, an opening based on putting your pawns on f5, e6, and d5 with Black. Using his own games, Carlsen shows us the ideas that he pioneered or applied to beat the likes of Vishy Anand and Fabiano Caruana with
Hou Yifan: My Career So Far Learn from women's world champion, GM Hou Yifan, as she describes her career highlights. GM Hou Yifan 7 Lessons Mastery

Cuban Chess: Dominguez On Capablanca Why is Jose Raul Capablanca still admired a century after his reign as world champion? GM Leinier Dominguez shows off some of Capablanca's greatest brilliancies! GM Leinier Dominguez Perez 5 Lessons Mastery
Learn The Evans Gambit Learn to play one of the sharpest and most exciting openings in all of chess! M Chess.com Coach 3 Lessons Mastery

How To Attack Without Sacrificing World Champion Magnus Carlsen teaches you how to attack! By going through some of his best games, Magnus shows his method of quietly closing in on the opponent's king, even without giving up material. GM Magnus Carlsen 4 Lessons Mastery
Perfect Chess Games Have you ever played a perfect chess game? See if you can find the moves from amazing games that earned 100% Game Review scores. NM Jeremy Kane 5 Lessons Mastery

My Best Loss Normally top players focus on their wins, but you can learn even more from your losses. Check out how memorable defeats have shaped the careers of four strong players. M Chess.com Coach 4 Lessons Mastery
